title: Storyboard Export
description: One-way down-transform of a scene_plan into t2i/i2v generation prompts. This is a RENDER-CONSTRAINED format (single shot <= 5s, 7-emotion enum, single-sentence English prompts); creative truth lives in scene_plan. Semantic lint (forbidden chars, i2v anchors, pause markers, narration/emotion line alignment) is enforced by lib/storyboard_export.py on top of this schema.

video_theme.description: Kebab-case or short theme slug used as the export directory name.

speech_model.description: TTS model the narration text targets. Vocal tags are only allowed for speech-2.8-hd / speech-2.8-turbo (enforced in lib).

narration_all.description: Full narration formed by concatenating scene narrations in order (enforced in lib).

scene_id.description: Sequential export shot number starting at 1 (enforced in lib).

scene_plan_scene_id.description: Traceability: the canonical scene_plan scene this shot was derived from.

narration.description: TTS-facing narration text. May contain <#x#> pause markers and (optionally, per speech_model) vocal tags — both linted in lib.

t2i_prompt.description: Single-sentence English text-to-image prompt. No ':', '/', '[', ']' (linted in lib).

i2v_prompt.description: Single-sentence English image-to-video prompt containing image-alignment, action, camera, and physics anchors (linted in lib).

duration_seconds.description: Render cap: a single shot never exceeds 5 seconds.

metadata.description: e.g. absorbed_from provenance, max_shot_seconds, scene_plan checkpoint reference, structure_template_ref.
